description: This file defines the ITransactionClient interface in the Orleans namespace, providing methods for executing transactions with delegates, including options for commit and rollback logic.

classes.name: ITransactionClient
classes.description: An interface for a transaction client with methods to run transactions asynchronously.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Runs a transaction, with delegate handling the transaction logic, either with or without a boolean success indicator.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Executes a transaction delegate with the specified transaction options. There are two overloads: one for delegate returning a Task, and one returning a Task<bool>.
